# Writing Great Documentation
Write documentation comments using triple slashes `///` supporting Markdown:

```rust
/// Calculates the checksum for a given network payload buffer.
///
/// # Examples
///
/// ```
/// let data = [1, 2, 3];
/// let sum: u32 = data.iter().map(|&x| x as u32).sum();
/// assert_eq!(sum, 6);
/// ```
pub fn calculate_checksum(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    data.iter().map(|&x| x as u32).sum()
}
```

Generate and open documentation:

```bash
cargo doc --open
```
